turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
Don't you worry. If it's an animal-
             related crime we will call you in.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
They found body parts out on Mesa
             Luna Road.
                 (off her sick feeling)
             Don't think the parts are actually
             on the road.

turns.speaker: p5
turns.quote:
People keep stealing them.   World's
             gone crazy.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: You have a good hardcover book?

turns.speaker: p7
turns.quote: You got all that we have.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
Straighten out some coat hangers and
          buy Dixie cups to stick on the end
          of them.
              (hands cop a bill)
          And get a receipt.

turns.speaker: p6
turns.quote:
Coyotes had a field day with this
          one; bones are scattered half a mile.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote:
Anyone else from the office coming?
          I could swear we have a couple of
          secretaries who haven't shown up
          yet.

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
Looks as if the victim was killed by
          that fire site, then his body was
          chopped up and burned. Animals
          scattered the parts.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote:
And you're smiling like an idiot
          because?

turns.speaker: p1
turns.quote:
The base bought this field from the
          city two months ago. City property
          only extends fifty feet from the
          center line of the road. Don't think
          it's our body, Chief.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote:
Mr. Deerfield? Jim Osher, can I
             have a word?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Come in, I'll just be a minute.

turns.speaker: p10
turns.quote:
Sir, I regret to inform you a body
             was found last night. Upon
             investigation we believe it to be
             the remains of your son, Specialist
             Michael Deerfield.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
Right.   They'll need me to identify
             him.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: He's doing fine, thank you for asking.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: It's not like he's the boy's father.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: Would you like to sit down, ma'am?

turns.speaker: p14
turns.quote: You fight a lot of monsters?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Okay then.    You go to sleep.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: You know that story isn't true.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Can I read the men's statements?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Yeah, just about to call you.

turns.speaker: p16
turns.quote:
Dad?  You there dad?
              (beat)
          Something happened, Dad.

turns.speaker: p15
turns.quote: Nice eyes.   Takes after his father.

turns.speaker: p15
turns.quote: You only remember the ones that tip.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: What's the name of the club?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: I think you have the wrong man.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I want the pen back, Nugent.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: That's quite the world you live in.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Why did you leave him there?

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote: So, one of them is on leave.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
The day I arrived the Sergeant told
             me all his men were back from liberty.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
This is Fred Gainley at the Buxton
             Sheriff's office. You missing a
             man? Because I have Robert Ortiez
             here on a Drunk and Disorderly who
             says he's one of yours.

turns.speaker: p20
turns.quote:
Thanks, I'll send someone over to
             get him.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
Check for priors and warrants.    And
             see if he owns a car.

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote:
I first arrested Bobby Ortiez when
             he was fourteen for drug trafficking.
             He got bail and the witness
             disappeared. Couple of misdemeanors
             after that, then a year and a half
             ago we liked him for drug smuggling.
             Suddenly he gets patriotic and joins
             up.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
How the hell did they let him in the
             Army?

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote:
No felony convictions. And they've
             been lowering the standards every
             month since this thing started.

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
He has a 1999 Chevrolet Malibu
             registered in his name.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Army can go after him, we can't.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Any idea where he'd go to ground?

turns.speaker: p21
turns.quote: Finding Bobby was never the problem.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Go to your motel. I will call you.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Take the street, take the street --

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
Fucking wetbacks; it's always knives,
             isn't it? You enjoy cutting him up?
             Did you?

turns.speaker: p3
turns.quote:
Hey! HEY!     What the hell are you
             doing?!

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
What was it? You wanted him to carry
             drugs for you and he wouldn't do it?
             You afraid he was going to tell on
             you? That it, Chico?

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote:
Wouldn't it be funny if the devil
             looked just like you?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
Come back here, you wetback prick,
             I'll show you what the devil looks
             like.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: I see you cracked him wide open.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: I didn't mean to hit you.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
That what passes for an apology in
             your world?
                 (as she uncuffs him)
             He isn't pressing charges. You're
             damn lucky I feel pity for you or
             I'd be doing it myself.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Is anyone going to question him?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
I questioned him, they questioned
             him, we searched his house, there is
             no evidence that he had anything to
             do with it!

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: We found him hanging in his room.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
My father gave it to me when I went
          to Vietnam. I gave it to Mike.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: It was in Bonner's pants pocket.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
...He was carrying it? He didn't
          leave a note -- he just put it in
          his pocket and then hung himself?

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote:
I'm afraid it's as close as we're
          going to get to a confession.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Bonner's car; what color is it?

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: So, why did he kill himself, Hank?

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote:
The remains will be shipped this
          afternoon, if you'd please just check
          the address of the funeral home.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote:
And, I'm afraid we have to keep the
          skull. Until the case is officially
          closed. I'm sorry.

turns.speaker: p23
turns.quote:
If I can be of any other help, please
          let me know.

turns.speaker: p18
turns.quote:
I wanted to say how sorry I am, what
             happened to Mike. And I need to
             apologize, for lying, about not seeing
             him that night. I just thought that,
             if I were Mike, I wouldn't want my
             parents to know.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Do you think Bonner killed him?

turns.speaker: p18
turns.quote:
No. I don't know. I don't understand
             any of this.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: What would he have against my boy?

turns.speaker: p18
turns.quote:
Nothing. I'm sorry.
                 (a moment)
             Mike tell you much about Bosnia?

turns.speaker: p18
turns.quote:
We seemed to always pull sentry duty,
             freezing our asses off. He used to
             try and convince me of the craziest
             things.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: Try to get you to wear pantyhose?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
I told him. Cuts the cold like
             nothing else.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
You just gotta make sure you aren't
             shot while wearing a pair, or you'll
             never live it down.

turns.speaker: p16
turns.quote:
Hey, asshole!
                 (to prisoner)
             It's okay, I'll help you. He's not
             going to hurt you again.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
Tell me that's your son's signature
          on his credit card receipt.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
We just assumed Mike was there.
          It's Penning's signature. Three
          meals: Penning, Long and Bonner.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Penning and Long. I want them now.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: I can't give them to you.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Damn right you can and you will.

turns.speaker: p12
turns.quote: I'm not the only one who made a deal.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: I want to hear the confession.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote:
I wanted to drop these by. I was
             going to knock, but I didn't want to
             spook your sitter.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
And you thought a stranger sitting
             out here staring at the house would
             make her feel more secure.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote:
They're for a Lobos game. That's
             football. Good game, Lobos against
             the Utah Utes.

turns.speaker: p8
turns.quote:
Thought it was worth a shot, before
             you turn the boy against the game
             forever.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote: Figured that's what they were for.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: I need to apologize to you.

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote: You got some serious issues, man.

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote:
I got an honorable discharge, if you
             can believe it.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: It's the Army, I'd believe anything.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
You know what this is?
                 (no answer)
             Mike took it and emailed it to me.
             Why would he do that?

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote: I don't know what anybody told you.

turns.speaker: p22
turns.quote:
There were standing orders. You're
             driving in convoy, someone or
             something gets in front of your
             vehicle, you do not stop. You stop,
             shitheads pop up with RPGs and kill
             you all dead.
                 (beat)
             First week in Iraq, we're driving
             down range, six of us in back, you
             can't see squat back there. Doc
             hits something. We hear it thump
             around underneath. He stops, gets
             out; drives on. Not a word. Later,
             some guys said we hit a kid, I don't
             believe it. You ask me, it was a
             dog. We killed a dog.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
So, my son has been driving me crazy
            ever since you came over. He wants
            a slingshot.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
Guess it could be worse, could be a
            bee-bee gun.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: It was Mike's favorite story, too.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: You be safe, son. Stay safe.

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote:
He asked for my help.    I didn't even
          listen.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
Every day Goliath would walk out
          into the valley and challenge someone,
          anyone, to fight him. No one would.
          Until David showed up and said, "I'll
          fight him." So, the king dressed
          David in his own armor, but it was
          too big and heavy.

turns.speaker: p14
turns.quote:
Why would the king let him fight a
          giant? He was just a boy.

turns.speaker: p2
turns.quote:
David? Yeah, I think he would have
             been really scared.

turns.speaker: p26
turns.quote: And I shouldn't take it down at night?

turns.speaker: p4
turns.quote: No, you leave it just like that.
